topic_score.why: Every player wants to know the exact moment they can start playing on launch day.

title: What time does GTA 6 ACTUALLY unlock!?
description: Rockstar says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on November 10 and needs up to 212 GB of free space. Pre-loading does not let you play early.

lines.say: Rockstar says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, in all regions. Here's what that means.

beats.text: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19.

lines.say: It is the same on both consoles: PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
Here's the twist. Digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on November 10.
If you saw November 12, that date is old. Rockstar moved digital pre-load forward to November 10.
It needs up to 212 gigabytes of free space, so check your storage now.
But pre-loading does not let you play early.
